description: ThunderNotes' only privileged code (D19, D26, D27): a message-list column, the carrier folder's global-search exclusion and prompt fetching.

functions.name: refreshColumn
functions.description: Redraws the ThunderNotes column (after tags changed).

functions.name: setCardPreviews
functions.description: The whole-email notes' one-line previews for the message list's cards, by '<account id>|<Message-ID>': the text and the note's colours for its lozenge (empty: none shown).

functions.name: getGlobalSearch
functions.description: Whether a folder is included in global search (Gloda).

functions.name: setGlobalSearch
functions.description: Same as the 'include in global search' checkbox in Folder Properties.

functions.name: prepareCarrierFolder
functions.description: Carrier folder setup: excluded from global search, checked for new messages like the Inbox.

functions.name: refreshFolder
functions.description: Fetches a folder's new messages from the server now; resolves when done.

functions.name: subscribeCarrierFolder
functions.description: If a top-level folder of an IMAP account exists on the server but isn't subscribed (and so is hidden from add-ons), subscribes it as the Subscribe dialog would. Resolves 'visible', 'subscribed', 'missing' or 'notImap'.

functions.name: focusMessagePane
functions.description: Gives the keyboard focus to the message shown in the current mail tab (e.g. back from the message list). Resolves whether it could.

functions.name: focusCurrentTab
functions.description: Gives the keyboard focus to the content of the current tab (the task view, just opened or brought to the front). Resolves whether it could.

functions.name: deviceName
functions.description: A default name for this device: the computer's name, plus the profile's when there are several profiles.

functions.name: expungeFolder
functions.description: Purges messages flagged as deleted from an IMAP folder on the server; resolves when done.
